title: Atlas 1.1 — Research Genome
description: Derived, regenerable view mapping each evidence-registry.json item to its position on the PROTOCOL.md section 10 publication chain. Never hand-edited; regenerate with tools/generate_research_genome.py. Does not alter or gate any item's real status.

publication_chain.description: verbatim from PROTOCOL.md section 10, in order

mapping_table_version.description: identifies which documented status->stage table in ATLAS_1_1_DESIGN.md section 3 was used

stage.description: one of publication_chain's values, or UNMAPPED if registry_status has no documented mapping
